name: Vase
summary: One side of this vase is decorated with a full-length figure of a woman student in 1940s dress standing on a mountain peak in front of a pine tree. She is the heroine from the novel Red Crag , published in 1962. It deals with communist underground resistance to the KMT (Nationalists) in warti
